name: expect-wdio-playground-mocha
description: Playground project for testing expect-webdriverio, on one browser and on a multi-remote browser

scripts.checks:all: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm test && pnpm run test:multi-remote
scripts.snapshots:update: pnpm run test --spec test/specs/snapshot.test.ts --updateSnapshots && pnpm run test --spec test/specs/visual-snapshot.test.ts --update-visual-baseline
